messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **federal‑holiday long weekends** that Canadians can count on in 2023. (Note that some provinces have extra holidays that can create additional long weekends – see the “Provincial notes” section below.)

| Long Weekend | Dates (2023) | Holiday(s) | Notes |
|--------------|--------------|------------|-------|
| **Family Day** | **Feb 18 – 20** | Family Day (Ontario, Saskatchewan, Alberta) | Family Day falls on Monday, so the weekend is Sat‑Mon. |
| **Good Friday** | **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday (federal holiday) | Good Friday is a federal holiday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Victoria Day** | **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day (federal holiday) | Victoria Day falls on Monday, so the weekend is Sat‑Mon. |
| **Labour Day** | **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day (federal holiday) | Labour Day falls on Monday, so the weekend is Sat‑Mon. |
| **Thanksgiving** | **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving (federal holiday) | Thanksgiving falls on Monday, so the weekend is Sat‑Mon. |
| **Christmas** | **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas Day (federal holiday) | Christmas falls on Monday, so the weekend is Sat‑Mon. |

### Provincial notes (additional long weekends that may affect your planning)

| Province | Extra Holiday | Date (2023) | Long Weekend? |
|----------|---------------|-------------|---------------|
| British Columbia | **St. Patrick’s Day** | Mar 17 (Friday) | Yes – Mar 15‑17 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Manitoba | **St. Patrick’s Day** | Mar 17 (Friday) | Yes – Mar 15‑17 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Ontario | **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | Already listed above |
| Saskatchewan | **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | Already listed above |
| Alberta | **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | Already listed above |
| Quebec | **Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day** | Jun 24 (Friday) | Yes – Jun 22‑24 (Sat‑Mon) |
| New Brunswick | **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | Already listed above |
| Nova Scotia | **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | Already listed above |
| Prince Edward Island | **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | Already listed above |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | **St. Patrick’s Day** | Mar 17 (Friday) | Yes – Mar 15‑17 (Sat‑Mon) |
| Yukon | **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | Already listed above |
| Northwest Territories | **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | Already listed above |
| Nunavut | **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | Already listed above |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - If you’re targeting a specific province, filter the list above to include only the holidays that apply there.  
> - For federal holidays that fall on a weekend (e.g., Canada Day on Saturday, Remembrance Day on Saturday), the government often observes the holiday on the following Monday. If you want to capture those “observed” dates, add them to your calendar logic (e.g., Canada Day observed on Monday July 3, 2023).

Let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need the provincial holiday lists for a particular province!
